Watch BCTV programming live and on demand!

Berks Community Television empowers people and engages the community through hyperlocal community media in the City of Reading and Berks County, Pennsylvania. Content is created and shared by local residents and features a wide variety of topics of interest to our community and beyond. 

For more information and content, visit our website at www.bctv.org.
